title: createNotifier's generic fan-out imposes no timeout on a channel's send() — a future channel implementation that never resolves/rejects would dangle forever (does not currently block sibling channels or the fire-and-forget caller, since sends are not chained; today's two real channels are both safe — telegram-channel.ts has its own 8s HTTPS timeout, whatsapp-channel.ts resolves synchronously). Worth a race-with-timeout wrapper in notify-channels.ts's send() before a third, possibly slower channel is added.
evidence: packages/meeting-bot/src/capture/notify-channels.ts:79-95 (send()) has no Promise.race/timeout around `channel.send(text)`; notify-channels.test.ts has no test with a never-settling fake channel
